spellbook.finance/limitations: Use bucketsState to distinguish an unfetched sold-history read from an observed fetch with no returned buckets. bucketsCoverage reports only the first and last stored bucket dates; it does not establish a wider source window.
series, buckets and asks come from different reads. Compare seriesCapturedAt, bucketsFetchedAt and asksCapturedAt before comparing their prices.
A day missing from series means SpellBook stored no price that day. It never means the price was zero. A null tcgLow means no Low was stored that day.

buckets come from the newest stored sold-prints fetch for the product. SpellBook fetches printings at $50 and up daily and cheaper printings less often, so check bucketsFetchedAt. A limitations line says when no fetch exists.

buckets include Near Mint and Lightly Played copies with English or unspecified language, grouped by the exact raw bucketStartDate strings. Bucket duration and end dates are not established. Known non-English rows, moderately played copies and worse conditions are excluded. When unspecified-language sold rows are present, limitations identifies that uncertainty. A bucket market is units-weighted and is not realized average proceeds.

Ask rows retain their condition and language. Unknown language stays null; use a known-English NM/LP ask cohort, and note that sold rows can include unspecified language so cohorts may differ. Shipping is the stored listing amount, not delivered cost.
asks is a stored snapshot. A listing in it may have sold since asksCapturedAt.
Magic printings only. Values are observations in USD. They are not quotes and do not reserve, buy or sell a card.

annotations.title: Read one card's price series, sales and asks

description: Read ONE Magic printing's stored daily price series, its recent sales and its current TCGplayer asks. Every caller gets all three, signed in or not. tcgplayerProductId is the exact printing's TCGplayer product id when known. series has one point per stored day, oldest first: priceUsd is the TCGplayer Market price SpellBook stored that day and tcgLow is the TCGplayer Low price. buckets sums Near Mint and Lightly Played sales of the requested finish with English or unspecified language by the exact raw bucketStartDate values returned by TCGplayer. The source response does not establish each bucket's duration or end date. Each row has units, transactions, a units-weighted bucket market and the lowest and highest recorded sale. If qualifying sold rows have unspecified language, limitations says so; known non-English rows are excluded. bucketsState distinguishes no stored fetch from an observed fetch; bucketsCoverage gives the first and last stored bucket dates when available. asks lists the TCGplayer listings of the requested finish from the newest unexpired snapshot, cheapest first, with item price, condition, language when known, listing shipping when known, quantity and seller name. asksTotal and asksTruncated report the source row count and truncation status when known. Each evidence family carries its own captured time. Call it after spellbook_printings_search names the printing, to see how its price moved over weeks or to compare its market series with recent sales and asks. Call spellbook_card_prices for today's price from every other source. It returns observations and limitations; it does not rank or recommend a printing. Compute any band, return or range yourself from series.

cardId.description: The exact Magic printing id (a Scryfall UUID) from spellbook_printings_search. Required.

finish.description: Which finish to read. Omit for nonfoil. Pass foil for a foil copy, because SpellBook stores foil prices, sales and asks apart from nonfoil.
